requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 构建一个节能照明系统，使用光敏电阻 A0、人体接近检测 HC-SR04（Trig=D8，Echo=D9）、PWM LED D9 和按钮 D2。只有当环境较暗且检测到有人接近时才自动点亮 LED；按钮用于强制常亮模式与自动模式切换。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: io_1 rises once (false->true), with io_0 arbitrary and io_4/io_5 arbitrary
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_2 becomes true and io_3 becomes 255.0 (forced-ON after button toggle)

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 构建一个节能照明系统，使用光敏电阻 A0、人体接近检测 HC-SR04（Trig=D8，Echo=D9）、PWM LED D9 和按钮 D2。只有当环境较暗且检测到有人接近时才自动点亮 LED；按钮用于强制常亮模式与自动模式切换。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: io_1 does not have a rising edge (held constant), set modeForced already true; vary io_0/io_4 while keeping io_5 true/false
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_2 stays true and io_3 stays 255.0 for all steps while no button rising edge occurs

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 构建一个节能照明系统，使用光敏电阻 A0、人体接近检测 HC-SR04（Trig=D8，Echo=D9）、PWM LED D9 和按钮 D2。只有当环境较暗且检测到有人接近时才自动点亮 LED；按钮用于强制常亮模式与自动模式切换。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Toggle button once to enter auto mode (modeForced false), then keep io_5=false while varying io_0 and io_4
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_2 is false and io_3 is 0.0 while ultrasonic validity is false in auto mode

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 构建一个节能照明系统，使用光敏电阻 A0、人体接近检测 HC-SR04（Trig=D8，Echo=D9）、PWM LED D9 和按钮 D2。只有当环境较暗且检测到有人接近时才自动点亮 LED；按钮用于强制常亮模式与自动模式切换。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: In auto mode (modeForced false), set io_5=true, set io_0 and io_4 such that proximity condition is not met (e.g., io_4<=0.0), and keep io_1 stable
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_2 is false and io_3 is 0.0 when proximity condition is not satisfied in auto mode
